# Protocol Requirements Checklist: Sync Protocol

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the frozen sync contract — feeds, cursors, batch semantics, retention, memberships on the user feed — before tasks are written. Audience: the PR reviewer and the C14 client team. Depth: release gate for a contract freeze.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/sync-api.md](../contracts/sync-api.md) · `docs/openapi/paths/sync.yaml`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Review run (owner away, delegated)**: the generating agent evaluated every item at the owner's delegated request (as in spec 012), fixed the gaps it found in the spec, the contract and the OpenAPI file, then marked the items that now pass. Items fixed in this run are noted.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all five open points the brief named (batch size, per-item vs all-or-nothing, ordering, key vs per-item idempotency, per-record PUT kept) answered as requirements, not only as clarifications? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–FR-016, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK002 Is every record type that rides each feed listed, including the ones later features add? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §5]
- [x] CHK003 Is the batch type/operation list complete for every whole-record write that exists today, with the excluded writes (archive, ownership transfer, PATCH edits) named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK004 Are the request-level refusals of the batch enumerated with their pointers and field codes? [Completeness, Spec §5, research R-4]
- [x] CHK005 Is the purge job's scope defined for every syncable type that can be tombstoned, including transfers' two horizons and memberships' user horizon? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, data-model Lifecycle effects]
- [x] CHK006 Are logging requirements stated for the purge job as well as for feeds and batches? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, §FR-027] — fixed in this run (FR-024 gained the purge summary line)
- [x] CHK007 Is the decision-record and documentation work required by CONTRIBUTING item 18 stated as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK008 Is the migration from the global sequence to the per-person counter specified, including how existing stamps are kept below new ones? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, data-model switch migration]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "position" defined per source so that the merged order of each feed is unambiguous (which column orders transfers into a wallet and memberships on a user feed)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, data-model Feed positions]
- [x] CHK010 Is it explicit that positions are unique within a scope, so a cursor can never split rows sharing one? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003] — fixed in this run
- [x] CHK011 Is the difference between `next_cursor` and `sync_cursor` specified, including the empty-page case? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, `ChangeFeedMeta`]
- [x] CHK012 Is the line between `400 INVALID_CURSOR` and `410 SYNC_CURSOR_EXPIRED` defined by a checkable rule (position vs purge horizon), not by age? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, research R-10]
- [x] CHK013 Is the mapping from a single write's status to `applied` / `conflict` / `rejected` exhaustive and unambiguous (e.g. `409 CATEGORY_IN_USE` is `rejected`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, contract table]
- [x] CHK014 Is the root of validation pointers in item problems specified (the item's `data`, not the batch body)? [Clarity, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK015 Is the meaning of a tombstoned `wallet_member` on the user feed stated in client terms (purge that wallet)? [Clarity, Spec §5, ADR-0017 rule 4]
- [x] CHK016 Is the treatment of unrecognised query parameters on feeds stated, and is it consistent with other collection endpoints? [Clarity, Consistency, Spec §FR-009] — fixed in this run (was "refused"; existing collections ignore unknown parameters)

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK017 Do the spec, `contracts/sync-api.md` and `sync.yaml` agree on paths, operationIds, limits (1–50; page 50/200), outcomes and codes? [Consistency, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK018 Is the batch's lack of an `Idempotency-Key` consistent with spec 003's rule that only three operations carry one, and is the deviation from the brief recorded? [Consistency, Spec reconcile table, ADR-0016 rule 7]
- [x] CHK019 Is the feed row shape consistent with spec 012's statement that the Transaction resource is the feed row (no separate `op`/`payload`)? [Consistency, Spec §5, spec 012 §5]
- [x] CHK020 Is the wallet-feed access rule for deleted wallets consistent with spec 010's tombstone-read rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK021 Is the lock order (categories → wallets → users) consistent with ADR-0014 rule 10 and every write path that now stamps a user row? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, research R-7]
- [x] CHK022 Does every error code named in the contract exist in the catalogue at its single status, with no new code introduced? [Consistency, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK023 Are the profile read reference and the per-type read endpoints named correctly (profile is read through `GET /me`)? [Consistency, Spec §5] — fixed during planning

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK024 Are the success criteria measurable with concrete counts and percentiles (gap safety over 1,000 interleaved writes, 5 pages for 1,000 changes, p95 budgets)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-008]
- [x] CHK025 Is a performance target stated for the user feed as well as the wallet feed? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006] — fixed in this run
- [x] CHK026 Does every invariant in §4 name a test file that fails when it breaks? [Traceability, Spec §4]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are partial-failure scenarios of a batch (one item failing unexpectedly, the server stopping mid-batch) specified, including what stays committed and how a resend behaves? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-013, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK028 Is losing access mid-walk specified for both the wallet feed (`404`) and the user feed (tombstoned membership)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 Is the session ending while a batch runs addressed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016a] — fixed in this run (authenticated once per batch)
- [x] CHK030 Is the full-resync path (absent cursor, after `410`) specified, including keeping queued writes? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK031 Are concurrent writers in one user scope (two devices) covered by a requirement, not only by the wallet case? [Coverage, Spec US3 scenario 4, §FR-018]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK032 Are duplicates of the same record within one batch defined? [Edge Case, Spec Clarifications, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK033 Is a profile item whose `id` is not the caller's profile defined? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Is the byte size of a batch bounded or explicitly left to per-field limits? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016a] — fixed in this run
- [x] CHK035 Is the purge's behaviour for a tombstoned wallet still referenced by a live transfer defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-023, research R-11]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK036 Are logging requirements explicit about what must never be logged (records, bodies, cursors, amounts, notes)? [Security, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK037 Is the cursor protected against tampering and cross-account reuse as a requirement? [Security, Spec §FR-007, research R-9]
- [x] CHK038 Is the client timeout expectation for a batch documented? [Non-Functional, Spec Assumptions, contract] — fixed in this run
- [x] CHK039 Is rate limiting explicitly decided (none, with a revisit trigger) rather than omitted? [Non-Functional, Spec §9 item 3]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK040 Is the deployment dependency of the counter switch (maintenance mode, single transaction, rerunnable) stated? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, research R-5] — fixed in this run (added to the spec's Assumptions)
- [x] CHK041 Are B9's obligations (stamping grants, removals and leaves on the member's user feed) recorded as dependencies rather than left implicit? [Dependency, Spec §9 item 1, ADR-0017]
